news.headline: Why Oceaneering (OII) stock is nosediving
news.summary: Shares of offshore services provider Oceaneering International (NYSE:OII) fell 17.5% in the afternoon session after the company reported a 26% year-over-year decline in net income attributable to the company for the third quarter of 2026.

news.headline: Oceaneering International Q3 Earnings Call Highlights
news.summary: Oceaneering International (NYSE:OII) reported third-quarter 2026 revenue growth across all of its operating segments, with adjusted EBITDA reaching its highest quarterly level since the fourth quarter of 2015. Revenue rose 6% from a year earlier to $785 million, while operating income increased 7%

news.headline: Oceaneering (NYSE:OII) beats Q3 2026 revenue but misses expectations on adjusted EPS
news.summary: Offshore services provider Oceaneering International (NYSE:OII) reported Q3 2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 5.6% year on year to $784.6 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.50 per share was 15.1% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
